Step:  
1232 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1232 < 1582).  
From 09-17 back 345 days:  
Go to start of year 1232: 09-17 → 01-01 is 260 days (Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + 17 days in Sep = 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31+17 = 260).  
345 − 260 = 85 days back into 1231.  
1231 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
From 12-31-1231 back 85 days:  
Dec 31 back 1 day → Dec 30, back 31 days in Dec → Nov 29, back 30 days in Nov → Oct 30, back 31 days in Oct → Sep 29.  
Check: 31 (Dec) + 30 (Nov) + 24 (Oct remaining after Oct 30) = 85 days back from Dec 31 → Sep 29, 1231.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1231-09-29
